This plot is not mine, I only rent it, so I will not spend big money on it. Last season I got one small bag of fertilizer from the coupon, and I will try again this year — if I get it, I put a little at planting and a little when the maize is knee-high. I cannot buy hybrid seed every year, so I keep seed from my last harvest like my father did. I have no money for pesticide and no water nearby, so my wife and I will just weed with the hoe, two or three times, and maybe I ask my brother for a few days when weeds are too much.
